title: Green Technology Book: Solutions for restoring climate-impacted ecosystems
content: The Green Technology Book on ecosystems reveals how restoration is shifting from periodic observation toward continuous environmental intelligence, using AI, digital twins and remote sensing to predict outcomes and optimize interventions. Across land, oceans, freshwater and the cryosphere, innovation increasingly blends engineering with nature-based solutions, prioritizing whole ecosystem function and climate adaptation. Advanced digital monitoring, reporting and verification systems turn ecological outcomes into measurable, investable assets, unlocking private finance, but long-term success depends on pairing emerging these emerging technologies with strong governance, community engagement, and decisive global climate policy.
